Hi all, I’m posting looking for advice on how to treat the pain I’m experiencing after getting my teeth professionally whitened. Hygienist did the “Zoom” whitening treatment. I got two fluoride varnishes because I started having random horrid shooting tooth pain in individual teeth and the first varnish did nothing; the second one helped for a few hours. Now I’m just having nonstop throbbing pain in the lower teeth that have a permanent retainer attached. Tylenol didn’t help and because of my sensitive stomach I can’t take any NSAIDs. sensodyne isnt helping, orajel 4x worked for about five minutes, now I’m just in constant pain. If there’s nothing I can do then how long will this last?? I appreciate any and all advice
